verdict.rationale: MailerSend is a SaaS email/SMS service that handles customer data, so a buyer can fairly ask whether it offers an AI-training opt-out. Nothing in the evidence pack covers AI training, data-use policies or opt-out controls. The MCP server and AI-tool connection evidence concerns integrations, not training-data privacy, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
